en.summary: The 2027 draft budget cuts the general government deficit to 0.6% of GDP (EUR 570m) and focuses on fighting poverty, middle-class purchasing power and tax relief. Under the 8 Jun 2026 tripartite deal (Resilienzpak), the government is extending energy support and rolling out a housing supply roadmap.
